messages:
jess-support: Heads-up: AcmePayments is getting a spike of 422s from tool bridge when calling billing.lookup_account in prod. Started ~13:31Z. High QPS (~100/s) and ~15% of calls are failing. Dropping logs and a failing payload below.

jess-support: ```
2026-03-17T13:31:30Z ERROR ToolExecutor validation_error tool=billing.lookup_account request_id=01E8ZJX
ToolValidationError: missing required field "user_id"
    at validateArgs (/srv/runtime/tool_validator.js:78:15)
    at executeTool (/srv/runtime/tool_executor.js:210:9)
    at Router.invoke (/srv/runtime/router.js:342:7)
payload: {"account_email":"ops@acme.com","context":{"trace_id":"abc123"}}
```

mike-cs: Customer reports it started after yesterday's router canonicalization tweak. They were sending ~100 rps and saw ~15% 422s.

arjun-runtime: Need a repro (headers + body) and which bridge/runtime commit is in prod. Also any tenant-specific routing rules?

jess-support: Repro curl (token scrubbed):

jess-support: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/invoke \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer xxxxx.SANITIZED" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model":"gpt-tool-aug-2026",
    "tool_call":{"name":"billing.lookup_account","arguments":{"account_email":"ops@acme.com"}}
  }'
```

emma-ml: Looks like the model only returned account_email. The official tool schema requires user_id (string, required). If router picked a variant that enforces full schema, validation will fail.

lucas-oncall: I reproduced with that curl — got 422 + same validation error. If I add "user_id":"u-2345" to arguments it succeeds. Quick workaround: inject user_id from JWT.sub into args before validation -> passes.

arjun-runtime: Confirmed: we rolled canonicalization change (commit c3f2a1b) yesterday which changed variant selection heuristics. It doesn't change schema rules, but it can alter which tool definition is chosen. So two issues: model returns only account_email; selected variant requires user_id.

arjun-runtime: Proposed mitigations:
- HOTFIX (fast): Bridge pre-call sanitizer: if args.user_id missing and auth token JWT.sub exists, copy JWT.sub -> args.user_id prior to schema validation.
- MID (config): Adjust router canonicalization to prefer more permissive variants when model-provided fields partially match.
- LONG: Improve model-tool contracts docs + add e2e model-to-tool selection tests.

jess-support: Customer prefers server-side fix rather than changing client. Said they'd accept a quick hotfix.

arjun-runtime: Pushing hotfix: bridge@v0.9.7-hotfix. Patch injects user_id from JWT.sub when missing (commit 5b9d2c7).

ops-bot: deploy started by arjun-runtime at 1934567905: deploy bridge v0.9.7-hotfix -> prod (canary 20%).

lucas-oncall: Canary looks stable; no 422s for the canary tenant. Doing telemetry checks across affected tenants.

ops-bot: deploy completed at 1934567924: bridge v0.9.7-hotfix -> prod (100%).

lucas-oncall: Post-deploy monitoring: AcmePayments error rate dropped from ~15% -> ~0.5% (some unrelated transient validation noise). Confirmed across their request timestamps.

mike-cs: Customer confirmed: "errors gone, thanks" :white_check_mark:. Documented workaround and timeline.

emma-ml: Follow-ups: add unit + integration tests that simulate model returning only account_email and verify bridge either injects user_id or routes to tolerant variant. Also update model onboarding checklist to warn about required-only args.

arjun-runtime: Filing infra ticket to revisit canonicalization logic and add a canary test. Ticket INF-2026-141.

jess-support: I'll close the support case and write a short incident note in #postmortems with timeline and mitigation.

mike-cs: tagging owners for visibility: @arjun-runtime @lucas-oncall @emma-ml @jess-support
